venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Friday 1/16.** Smoothly quick-paced: slow start and end, strong middle; waitlist exhausted by midnight. Many one-and-done tables early, more enthusiasts and investors in the middle turn; delivered past-menu selections amid swift turns. Comps $245.02. Door: frigid Friday but kept the place full; slower build, large parties popped at 10pm; used same-day investor reservations and shorter wait quotes; standing used only for friends and accidental waitlist removals; died around 12:30. Kitchen: none. Repairs: right vanity bulb out in ground-floor bathroom vestibule.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Friday 1/16.** Garden: slower, most guests after 9pm; opening bartender and host cut as labor/revenue didn't justify them. Around 10:15 larger walk-in parties and a quickly moved waitlist; Garden closed ~11 (half the space kept for seating, with a 6-top and 7-top served Marquee menu). D&C: cold, quiet start; picked up around 8; most of the room filled by 10:15 with strong floor comms; full room until ~12:30; normal last call but guests allowed to linger while waiting for rides in the cold. Fell short of daily goal but a solid shift; ticket pacing could be tighter so the bar isn't overwhelmed. Kitchen: 11.79% of sales; oysters 86'd early (working on a solve as demand grows); 2 gallons of milk tossed past sell date. MOD: Kevin / Cory / Josh.
